# Claude Code 2.1.316 headless and response-only identity

`dist-inventory.json` freezes the npm wrapper, Darwin arm64 package, and Linux x64 package from the previous ceiling `2.1.312` through official stable `2.1.316`, including the unpublished `2.1.313` point between them. The re-downloaded `2.1.312` tarball and both `claude` digests match Research 459. Every tarball was checked against current npm SHA-512 integrity and hashed per file. No downloaded executable was run. The same file records the exact CLI option inventory deltas, the SDK declaration deltas, and the bounded embedded-runtime growth at `2.1.315`.

`marker-ledger.json` records the exact marker and stream-json help-line arrays on the four compared points. `selected-control-flow.json` binds the measured selected JS on those points to the executable hashes: instruction-form prompt-hook blocking, PreToolUse deny before dispatch, rewrite collection and the ask-to-deny recheck, the Stop block cap default 8, and Stop/SubagentStop `stop_hook_active` reentry. Identifier remangling changes the snippets. The decision tokens do not. `response-only-isolation.json` freezes `--safe-mode`, the builtin-only plugin filter, init fields, the permission-mode default mapper, the interactivity gate, and `@builtin` plugin ids on the same points. `cc-plugin-claude-platform` still requires `isInteractive()`, which the print detector makes false for `-p`; `2.1.314` adds internal interactivity bookkeeping without changing that value. Easel also keeps its `remote_cowork` registration; these routes are not `remote_cowork`.

`forked-stream-surface.json` re-checks the surface Research 374 stopped on for `2.1.287`: the provider's per-block assistant frames that may share `message.id` with a null `message.stop_reason` and non-final usage, the non-null `parent_tool_use_id` inside a subagent, and the `context:"fork"` command definitions. That description is byte-identical on both platforms from `2.1.312` through `2.1.316`, and the adapter's null-stop-reason projection is covered by the named activity test. `--forward-subagent-text` is an unpassed opt-in on both routes.

`headless-identity.json` and `headless-protocol.json` are the headless claim. `response-only-identity.json` and `response-only-protocol.json` are the response-only claim. At observation, npm `latest` and GitHub latest non-prerelease agree on `2.1.316`. npm `stable` remains the delayed channel at `2.1.309`. npm `next` is also `2.1.316`. `2.1.313` is absent from npm and from GitHub tags, and `2.1.315` was published to npm without a public tag or release. npm `next` advanced to `2.1.317` during the run while `latest` and GitHub stayed at `2.1.316`, so `2.1.317` stays unqualified `UnverifiedNewer` and `2.1.318` is the first unpublished point. The host `claude` at `2.1.314` is byte-identical to the official Darwin arm64 `2.1.314` artifact; its `--version` was read and no provider work ran. Research 466 records the qualification. Claude Agent ACP and the Claude Agent SDK stay separate claims.
